verbatim: The approved ordinance does not allow Luther to accept new rezoning applications or specific-use permit requests
The Board hereby enacts a six-month temporary moratorium
The Moratorium shall end on October 9th, 2026, unless terminated or extended by a resolution of the Board
The measure also places a moratorium through Dec. 31, 2026, on approvals of existing applications seeking rezoning or special-use permits for data center projects.
